document.abstract: This document defines UHDTV video payload mapping of formats as shown in Table 1 into Multi-link 10Gb/s [nominal] Signal/Data Interface. This document also defines mapping of ANC, payload ID and other ancillary data as well as optical characteristics and a connector.
